name: Hand Head
motion: Fingers flex and central eye blinks; alternating hunched humanoid steps
action: Palm draws back and slaps; fingers curl on hurt; legs fold and palm droops over the body
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PIXEL ART animation sheet for Hand Head. Use ONLY row 4, column 2 of supplied atlas for exact identity. hunched purple humanoid with a LARGE FLESH-COLORED FIVE-FINGERED HAND replacing its head, one yellow eye IN THE PALM, two normal purple arms and two clawed legs, no normal human head. Preserve its silhouette, proportions, palette and anatomy.
Exactly SIXTEEN full-body poses in a FOUR-COLUMN FOUR-ROW equal square grid. Same RIGHT-facing slight top-down three-quarter camera, palette, head/body scale and pixel size in all cells. Genuine coarse 16-bit RPG PIXEL ART: author at native48x48 logical pixels per cell and enlarge NEAREST NEIGHBOR. Hard chunky square clusters, dark stepped outlines and a small flat-color palette. No smooth digital painting, tiny brush texture, gradients, antialiasing, blur, bloom or subpixel shading.
Every entire horn, wing, tail, tongue, staff, axe and claw must fit wholly inside its ORIGINAL equal cell, with at least 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on EVERY edge. Common lowest foot/body ground baseline at 85% cell height. Airborne offsets are game-rendered: keep lowest body edge at that baseline even for tucked flight poses. Consistent body scale across sixteen poses; the final collapsed creature stays recognizable and substantial, not tiny particles.
Every row must contain at least THREE unmistakably different silhouettes at native48. True transparent alpha. No checkerboard, opaque background, labels, words, numbers, guides, borders, shadows, ground lines, detached particles/flame specks/electrical dots, speed streaks or extra monsters. All fire/electric accents must be small flat pixel clusters attached to the body. Return the complete transparent 4x4 pixel sheet.
Row ONE four clearly different small idle poses based on Fingers flex and central eye blinks.
Row TWO four sequential travel poses based on alternating hunched humanoid steps. IMPORTANT alternating walking feet: Row TWO column ONE raises the foot on the IMAGE-RIGHT side, bent knee and visible dark sole, with IMAGE-LEFT foot down flat. Column TWO plants IMAGE-RIGHT foot while LEFT heel lifts. Column THREE must raise the OPPOSITE IMAGE-LEFT foot BEHIND the body, knee bent backwards, dark underside visible with a transparent gap beneath it, while IMAGE-RIGHT foot stays DOWN FLAT as support. Column FOUR plants LEFT foot while RIGHT heel lifts. C1 and C3 must raise OPPOSITE feet. Do not repeat the front/right raised leg in both C1 and C3. Counter-swing arms and shift hips/hem with each leg. If robed, lift LEFT hem in C3 to reveal the raised left boot.
Row THREE C1 WIND-UP, C2 clear STRIKE, C3 RECOVERY from Palm draws back and slaps, C4 HURT recoil from fingers curl on hurt. 
Row FOUR four progressively lower DEFEAT stages ending in a substantial complete resting body based on legs fold and palm droops over the body.
